posts.title: 13 YEARS DOWN, FOREVER TO GO!
posts.description:
13 YEARS DOWN, FOREVER TO GO! 
Congratulations to our Executive Secretary, Atty. Riczen Gingoyon, and Kherstine June, on your wedding!
May your journey as husband and wife be filled with love, laughter, understanding, and countless blessings. Here’s to building a beautiful life together and choosing each other every single day.

posts.title: SERBISYO CARAVAN SA BARANGAY CASUNTINGAN
posts.description:
SERBISYO CARAVAN SA BARANGAY CASUNTINGAN 
Another successful stop for our Mandaue ONE-Stop Serbisyo Caravan! Daghang salamat sa Barangay Casuntingan officials, our City Councilors, partner agencies, ug sa tanang Mandauehanon nga niadto aron mo-avail sa atong mga libreng serbisyo.
From free laboratory tests, medicines, and X-rays to legal assistance, livelihood support, employment opportunities, civil registry services, and government transactions with our national agency partners, we continue bringing government closer to the people and making essential services more accessible for every Mandauehanon.
Kita-kits ta sa Barangay Paknaan karong October 24! 
#ONEMandaue See less

posts.title: BAG-ONG SCHOOL BUILDING PARA SA TIPOLO NHS!
posts.description:
BAG-ONG SCHOOL BUILDING PARA SA TIPOLO NHS! 
After years of waiting, a new three-storey school building is finally underway at Tipolo National High School through the partnership of the City Government of Mandaue, Congresswoman Emmarie "Lolypop" Ouano-Dizon, and the Cebu-Mandaue Filipino Chinese Chamber of Commerce and Industry, Inc. (CMFCCCII).
Daghang salamat sa CMFCCCII, led by President Johnson Ng, for this generous donation and for investing in the future of our Mandauehanon learners.
Uban ni Cong. Lolypop, CMFCCCII officers, ug Opao Brgy. Captain Jojo Dizon, dili lang classrooms ang atong gitukod, kundili dugang kahigayonan para sa mga damgo ug kaugmaon sa atong mga kabatan-onan. 
#ONEMandaue See less

posts.title: 𝗖𝗟𝗔𝗦𝗦 𝗔𝗗𝗩𝗜𝗦𝗢𝗥𝗬 | 𝗢𝗖𝗧 𝟭𝟲
posts.description:
𝗖𝗟𝗔𝗦𝗦 𝗔𝗗𝗩𝗜𝗦𝗢𝗥𝗬 | 𝗢𝗖𝗧 𝟭𝟲
Based on the latest Air Quality Advisory from EMB 7 as of 4:00 PM today, October 15, the Metro Cebu Air Quality Index (AQI) has improved to 140, classified as “Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups,” from the previous “Very Unhealthy” level.
Face-to-face classes in all levels, both public and private schools in Mandaue City, shall continue as scheduled tomorrow, October 16.
While air quality has improved, everyone is still encouraged to limit prolonged or strenuous outdoor activities, especially children and other sensitive groups, and to wear a face mask when necessary.
Amping kanunay, Mandauehanon.

posts.title: 𝗪𝗔𝗟𝗔𝗬 𝗞𝗟𝗔𝗦𝗘 | 𝗢𝗖𝗧 𝟭𝟱
posts.description:
𝗪𝗔𝗟𝗔𝗬 𝗞𝗟𝗔𝗦𝗘 | 𝗢𝗖𝗧 𝟭𝟱
Based on the latest Air Quality Advisory from EMB 7 as of 4:00 PM today, October 14, the Metro Cebu Air Quality Index (AQI) is at 177, classified as “Very Unhealthy.” As a precautionary measure, the suspension of face-to-face classes in all levels, both public and private schools in Mandaue City, is hereby extended to tomorrow, October 15.
All public schools shall automatically shift to Alternative Delivery Modes (ADM), while private schools are given the autonomy to make necessary arrangements, including the adoption of ADM or make-up classes, based on the assessment and discretion of their respective school administrators.
Kasabot kaayo ko sa kabalaka sa atong mga ginikanan, estudyante, magtutudlo, ug mga negosyante sa padayon nga pagsuspenso sa face-to-face classes. Apan sa pagkakaron, ang panglawas ug kaluwasan sa atong mga anak maoy atong unahon. We must also ensure learning continuity while protecting everyone from the risks of poor air quality.
Everyone is advised to stay indoors as much as possible and wear a face mask when going outside to minimize exposure to poor air quality.
Amping kanunay, Mandauehanon.
#ONEMandaue See less
